title: De Morgan transformation of a circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $n$ input vertices, and suppose each gate has distinct arguments and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. The De Morgan transformation of $C$ is the circuit obtained by rewriting its gates with the De Morgan gate gadget.
hypotheses_covered: Every NOT gate has exactly one argument
